english.title: Proceeds of Crime - prejudice investigation
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), knowing or suspecting that a

(A)_[confiscation investigation]_
(B)_[civil recovery investigation]_
(C)_[money laundering investigation]_
(D)_[detained cash investigation]_
(E)_[exploitation proceeds investigation]_
(F)_[detained property investigation]_
(G)_[frozen funds investigation]_
(H)_[cryptoasset investigation]_

(I)_[was being]_
(J)_[was about to be]_

conducted by an appropriate officer,

(K)_[made a disclosure which was likely to prejudice the investigation]_
(L)_[falsified, concealed, destroyed or otherwise disposed of documents relevant to the investigation]_
(M)_[caused the falsification, concealment, destruction or disposal of documents relevant to the investigation]_
(N)_[permitted the falsification, concealment, destruction or disposal of documents relevant to the investigation]_

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies from the 25th April 2024 due to changes made by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023 that expanded the remit of the offence to cover cryptoasset investigations. For the offence applying before this date, see H5064 (24th February 2003 and 5th April 2008), H101660 (6th April 2008 to 5th April 2010), H101661 (6th April 2010 to 30th January 2018), H101662 (31st January, 2018 to 25th April, 2024) .(ii) See subsections 342(3) and (6) for circumstances in which a person does not commit this offence.
(iii) See subsection 342(4) for an explanation of when a disclosure falls within this section.
(iv) MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
